The National University of Río Cuarto (Universidad Nacional de Río Cuarto, UNRC) is a public university located in Río Cuarto, Córdoba, Argentina. It was established on June 1, 1971, as part of the Taquini Plan, an initiative by the Argentine government to decentralize higher education and encourage university establishments in various regions of the country.

The university offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in a diverse range of disciplines including natural, exact, and basic sciences, social sciences, health sciences, engineering, agricultural sciences, veterinary sciences, education, and humanities. It is also known for its research and extension activities, contributing to the scientific, educational, cultural and economic development of the region.

Its campus is spread over an area of about 290 hectares and includes facilities such as a central library, museums, laboratories, academic units, administrative offices, and dormitories. The campus also boasts a radio station, sports complexes, and a university hospital. The university is also home to a number of research centers and institutes specialized in different fields. 

The institution places a great emphasis on community outreach and social development projects. It is also known for its commitment to environmental sustainability.

The National University of Río Cuarto is governed by a rector and vice rector, chosen by the university community every four years. It also has a University Council that deals with matters related to academic life, scientific research, and university governance. As a public university, education at UNRC is essentially free for both national and foreign students, with some exceptions for certain graduate and postgraduate courses or programs.

According to the Argentine university ranking prepared by local company QS Quacquarelli Symonds, the National University of Río Cuarto ranks among the top 50 institutions in the country. It has also been recognized for its academic work and research capacity at the national and international levels.

Notable alumni from this university include a number of public officials, popular figures in the arts and sciences, and successful entrepreneurs.
